Name: Erastus
Summary: Erastus was one of Paul's companions sent ahead from Ephesus into Macedonia with Timothy while Paul stayed in Asia. He is traditionally identified with the chamberlain of Corinth named in the later epistles, though Acts does not say so.
KeyStory: Erastus was sent ahead with Timothy into Macedonia while Paul finished his work in Asia.
LifeLesson: Advance parties go first and unseen. Erastus carried the mission into Macedonia ahead of Paul.
